standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, adventurer. Thank you for freeing me from the Devourer. I would be alone now. Scabaras teaches us to remain isolated, and I have much to think about.

using-dawn-scarab-egg-on-him.text: You show the egg to the High Priest.

using-dawn-scarab-egg-on-him.npc: Adventurer... what is this? It looks like a scarab egg, but is unlike any I've seen before.

using-dawn-scarab-egg-on-him.player: To be honest, I'm not sure, but I think you should have it. It has more hope of hatching with you than with me.

using-dawn-scarab-egg-on-him.npc: Thank you, adventurer. I know not what will come of this, but I feel you have done the right thing. May Scabaras continue to guide you.

using-dawn-scarab-egg-on-him.text: You give the egg to the High Priest.
